title: 第13章 遇上抢劫的了第14章 陆飞烟
slug: 穿越修真界开局娶了美女大师姐
lines: 接下来的两天，没有出现什么大的波折。
终于，一个大大的山谷出现在莫凡眼前。两座连绵的大山耸立，从山腰开始就是云雾缭绕。两座大山之间，有一个宽约三里的入口。由于平时进出山谷探险的人络绎不绝，在谷口已经形成一个小集镇。集镇上吃喝住行一应俱全。
莫凡走进集镇，他想买一张地图。黑风谷内很多险地，有高阶凶兽的地盘，有毒瘴聚集之地等等，这些险地对于修为低的武者来说，踏入即死。而有商家专门出售地图，标注这些险地，还标注哪些地方可能出现什么灵草。
来到一个挂着“黑风商行”招牌的商行门口，一个店小二热情地迎上来：“公子，想要买什么？小的可以为您推荐。”
“我想要一幅黑风谷的地图。”莫凡答道。
“好嘞，敢问，您是要普通的地图，还是等级比较高的地图？”
“地图还分等级？”
“是的，普通地图比较粗略，线路比较少，主要标注一些险地的位置。至于等级高的地图，不仅线路比较多，除了标注险地外，还标注一些机缘之地，比如何处大概率能寻到灵草、灵兽，可能还能探寻到一些大能生前留下的洞府。”
“价格呢？”莫凡对高等级的地图大感兴趣。
“普通地图一百枚金币，高等级的地图五百枚金币。”
“嘶，这价格，跟抢钱差不多啊。”莫凡差点被吓到。
金币是玄武大陆通用的货币，普通人，低阶修士，都用金币购买东西。这次出门，莫唯风给了莫凡一千枚金币。
从没出过门的莫凡，还以为这是一笔大财富呢，谁知道这一路走来，住宿打尖、吃饭，就已经花去了他将近一百枚金币了。
“给我来一份普通地图就好。”莫凡咬牙掏出一百枚金币。
店小二接过莫凡的金币，然后从柜台里取出一幅卷轴交给莫凡。
地图到手，莫凡不再耽搁，直奔黑风谷。
进入山谷三四里，就开始山势起伏，丛林森然，到处都笼罩着薄薄的白雾。
莫凡选了一条线路，慢慢往前走。
走了半天，没出现什么危险。这里还是黑风谷的外围，危险的凶兽都已经被捕杀殆尽。
来到一个山谷，溪水潺潺。四个满脸横肉的大汉正在烤着一只凶兽。
看到莫凡，其中一个大汉朝莫凡吹了声口哨。
莫凡没有搭理，继续往前走。
那名大汉上前拦住莫凡，另外三人则从其他三个方向将莫凡的去路全部堵住。
“各位，这是干什么？”莫凡还算冷静，因为这四人修为跟他相差不大。
“小子长得细皮嫩肉的，是哪个大家族或者宗门出来历练的吧？”拦在前面的大汉满脸戏谑。
“既然知道，你还敢拦我？”莫凡不置可否。
“小子，口气挺横啊。别以为你在家族里牛皮哄哄的，来到这里，被抛尸野外也没人知道。”身后的一名大汉说道。
“想杀我，也要看你有没有那个本事。”莫凡不动声色。
content_en:
There were no major twists and turns in the next two days.
Finally, a large valley appeared in front of Mo Fan. Two continuous mountains stand tall, shrouded in clouds and mist from the mountainside. Between the two mountains, there is an entrance about three miles wide. Due to the constant stream of people exploring in and out of the valley, a small market town has been formed at the entrance of the valley. Food, drink, housing and transportation are all available in the market town.
Mo Fan walked into the market town and wanted to buy a map. There are many dangerous places in Black Wind Valley, including the territory of high-level ferocious beasts, places where poisonous miasma gathers, etc. For warriors with low cultivation level, entering these dangerous places will result in death. There are merchants who specialize in selling maps, marking these dangerous places, and also marking where some magical herbs may appear.
Arriving at the door of a trading firm with the signboard "Heifeng Trading Firm", a waiter greeted him enthusiastically: "Sir, what do you want to buy? I can recommend it to you."
"I want a map of Black Wind Valley." Mo Fan replied.
"Okay, I'd like to ask, do you want an ordinary map or a map with a higher level?"
"Is the map still divided into levels?"
"Yes, ordinary maps are rough and have fewer lines. They mainly mark the locations of some dangerous places. As for high-level maps, they not only have more lines. In addition to marking dangerous places, they also mark some places of opportunity, such as where you can find spiritual grasses and spiritual beasts with a high probability, and you may also be able to explore some caves left by great powers during their lifetimes."
"What's the price?" Mo Fan was very interested in high-level maps.
"A normal map costs 100 gold coins, and a high-level map costs 500 gold coins."
"Hey, this price is almost like robbing money." Mo Fan was almost frightened.
Gold coins are the common currency in Xuanwu Continent. Ordinary people and low-level monks all use gold coins to buy things. This time when he went out, Mo Weifeng gave Mo Fan a thousand gold coins.
Mo Fan, who had never been out before, thought this was a huge fortune. Who knew that he had spent nearly a hundred gold coins on accommodation and meals along the way.
"Just give me a normal map." Mo Fan gritted his teeth and took out a hundred gold coins.
The waiter took Mo Fan's gold coins, then took out a scroll from the counter and handed it to Mo Fan.
With the map in hand, Mo Fan stopped delaying and headed straight to Black Wind Valley.
Three or four miles into the valley, the mountains began to undulate, the jungle became dense, and a thin white mist shrouded everything.
Mo Fan chose a route and walked forward slowly.
After walking for a long time, there was no danger. This is still the outskirts of Black Wind Valley, and all dangerous beasts have been hunted down.
We came to a valley with a gurgling stream. Four big men with sinister faces were roasting a ferocious beast.
Seeing Mo Fan, one of the big men whistled at Mo Fan.
Mo Fan ignored him and continued walking forward.
The big man stepped forward to stop Mo Fan, and the other three blocked Mo Fan's path from the other three directions.
"Everyone, what are you doing?" Mo Fan was still calm because the cultivation level of these four people was not much different from his.
"You have such a thin skin and tender flesh. Did you come from some big family or sect to get some training?" The big man standing in front of him said with a joking look on his face.
"Now that you know, you still dare to stop me?" Mo Fan was noncommittal.
"Boy, you have a strong tone. Don't think that you are a bully in the family. When you come here, you will be thrown into the wild and no one will know." A big man behind him said.
"If you want to kill me, it depends on whether you have the ability." Mo Fan remained calm.
